LESSON: SACREDNESS OF LIFE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living Today
Topic 6.3: Sacredness of life
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sacredness of life, part of Christian Living Today in Grade 8 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How do you uphold sacredness of life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain the meaning of sacredness of life,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sacredness of life in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. elaborate sacredness of life from the scriptures provided,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sacredness of life in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. discuss how the right to life is violated today,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sacredness of life in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. evaluate causes of suicide in today’s society,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sacredness of life in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. examine causes of abortion among teenage girls,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sacredness of life in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

F. analyse the consequences of violating the right to life,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sacredness of life in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

G. compile values and life skills needed to uphold sacredness of life.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sacredness of life in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

A. explain the meaning of sacredness of life,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the meaning of sacredness of life,
2. read, Genesis 4:10-11, Genesis 9:6, Exodus 20:13, Deuteronomy 18:10, , Proverbs 6:16-17 & Matthew 6:25 and summarise key points on sacredness of life on a chart,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sacredness of life together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
